features.feature: wedge (start)/(end) forms and bare forms (!cresc(start)! !cresc(end)! !dim(start)! !dim(end)!; bare !crescendo! !dim! !w!)
features.evidence: 7 <wedge> in <direction-type>: crescendo,stop,diminuendo,stop from the (start)/(end) pairs, plus 3 start-only wedges (crescendo, diminuendo, crescendo) from bare crescendo/dim/w — bare forms emit a valid start but never a stop, so they must be closed with any stop token or MuseScore gets an unterminated hairpin

features.feature: wedge niente (al niente / dal niente hairpin)
features.syntax_source: none — no token in wedgeMap, no doc, no test mentions niente; !n! is only the niente DYNAMIC in dynaMap
features.evidence: 0 <wedge> carries a niente attribute anywhere in the codebase's output; guessed syntaxes produce propagating garbage: <other-articulation>dim(niente)</other-articulation> x8 (D31-style spread to all notes)
features.proposal: add wedgeMap tokens !dim-niente(! -> <wedge type="diminuendo" niente="yes"> and !cresc-niente(! -> <wedge type="crescendo" niente="yes">, closed by the existing !dim)! / !cresc)! stop tokens — same paired-paren convention as every other wedge token

features.syntax_source: none — no 'dashes' token anywhere in abc2xml.py, FEATURES.md, docs/ or TESTFILES/
features.evidence: 0 <dashes> elements; instead <other-articulation>dashes(</other-articulation> x8 and dashes) x5 (propagating unknown-deco fallback)
features.proposal: !dashes(! / !dashes)! -> <direction-type><dashes type="start"/> and type="stop", with a dashnum counter for the number attribute exactly like s.glisnum/s.slidenum; typical use: cresc./dim. text continuation lines

features.syntax_source: none — 'bracket' in the codebase only refers to part-group brackets (%%score [..]) and volta brackets
features.evidence: 0 direction-type <bracket> elements; instead <other-articulation>bracket(</other-articulation> x8 and bracket) x5 (propagating unknown-deco fallback)
features.proposal: !bracket(! / !bracket)! -> <direction-type><bracket type="start" line-end="down" line-type="solid"/> and <bracket type="stop" line-end="down"/>, numbered like glissandos; the paired-paren decoration convention matches the rest of the house syntax

cross_cutting_hazard: The D31 mechanism is generic: ANY decoration token the converter does not recognise is both emitted as <other-articulation> on the current note AND re-queued via staffDecos->s.nextdecos (abc2xml.py line 1810), so it stamps every subsequent note in the voice to end of tune. Measured on glissando (8/8 notes), dashes( (8/8 from note 1), bracket( (8/8), dim(niente) (8/8). Any FIX for D31 should clear the token instead of re-queueing unknowns.
